research_interests: Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Computational Linguistics, focusing on language understanding, text classification, and context-aware models.
Medical Text Analysis and Healthcare Informatics, leveraging AI to improve clinical decision-making and patient data analytics.
Multimodal Learning and Contextual Embeddings, integrating diverse data types like images, text, and signals for richer AI applications.
Explainable AI and Model Interpretability, ensuring transparency and trustworthiness in AI-driven systems and predictive models.
Topic Modeling, Semantic Search, and Representation Learning for uncovering hidden patterns and enhancing information retrieval.
Bengali Linguistics and Low-Resource Language Processing, addressing challenges in underrepresented languages through computational approaches.

projects.title: Contextual Sarcasm Detection (Undergraduate Thesis)
projects.description: Developed an encoder-encoder cross-attention model for detecting contextual sarcasm. Combined CLIP for image encoding and mBERT for text processing, achieving 95% accuracy. Currently refining a custom multimodal architecture for enhanced performance.

projects.title: Clickbait Content Detection
projects.description: Built a tool to detect clickbait on social media using multimodal analysis. Integrated CLIP and mBERT models, achieving 95% accuracy in initial evaluations. Currently extending the dataset and refining model reliability.

projects.title: Medical Triage Classification
projects.description: Developed a BERT-based model for classifying medical triage notes. Implemented regex and medical dictionaries for preprocessing and achieved 83% accuracy. Also explored multimodal and EDBERT-based enhancements for improved classification.

projects.title: US Election Data Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed Twitter posts using topic modeling, BERT-based semantic search, and GraphRAG. Clustered embeddings with t-SNE and HDBSCAN for extracting election-related insights. Proposed an alternative to traditional exit polls, with ongoing evaluation.
